githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.5 Beta 8 adds native profile customization, expanded profiles with widgets, and account import from the Discord desktop app. It also introduces an interactive message appearance preview, first-launch theme customization, and improvements to slowmode, message delivery, and everyday navigation.

## Profile customization and widgets

- Added a native editor for your main profile and per-server identity, including display names, nicknames, pronouns, bios, avatars, and banners.
- Added customization for profile colors, display-name fonts and effects, avatar decorations, nameplates, profile effects, and frames available to your account.
- Added avatar and banner image selection, GIF browsing, cropping, and color controls with live previews.
- Added custom status editing with emoji and expiration options, alongside server tag selection.
- Added expanded profiles with full widget collections, personal widgets, game lists, and browsable game details.
- Added widget editing and drag-to-reorder controls, plus confirmation before leaving Settings with unsaved profile changes.
- Improved custom display-name rendering across conversations, long-name wrapping, and animated cosmetic previews.

## Sign-in and first launch

- Added account import from the Discord desktop app, with a picker for choosing saved accounts.
- Redesigned the welcome and sign-in screens and refined authenticator, SMS, and backup-code entry.
- Added theme customization during first-launch setup and made Sakura pink the default theme.

## Appearance and themes

- Redesigned Appearance settings with an interactive conversation preview that updates as message preferences change.
- Added drag-to-reorder controls for GIF, sticker, and emoji buttons in the message input bar.
- Added an option to keep grouped message timestamps visible without hovering.
- Added saturation and hexadecimal color controls to the theme designer.
- Improved code-text contrast and unread-indicator visibility in light appearance.

## Messaging and channel navigation

- Added slowmode countdowns and input-bar feedback, preserving drafts when a message cannot yet be sent.
- Fixed timed-out messages remaining stuck while awaiting confirmation, allowing explicit retry or discard and preserving late delivery confirmations.
- Kept the selected channel and channels with mentions visible in collapsed categories, alongside unread channels in unmuted categories.
- Fixed draft isolation across channels and accounts, incomplete message updates overwriting existing content, and stale avatar placeholders.

## Settings, diagnostics, and window behavior

- Added clickable Settings link cards in messages and diagnostic-file sharing with destination confirmation.
- Improved diagnostic capture coverage and bounded retained diagnostic data.
- Improved Escape-key navigation in GIF pickers and nested popovers, along with input handling while dialogs are open.
- Refined Settings sizing, profile scrolling, and modal alignment, and prevented duplicate app launches through the launch scripts.
- Added a Sponsor link to About settings.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.5-Beta-7...v0.1.5-Beta-8](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.5-Beta-7...v0.1.5-Beta-8)
discordAnnouncement:
**Profile customization, widgets, and Discord account import 🌙**

**Highlights**
- Edit your main and per-server profiles with avatars, banners, colors, display-name styles, and cosmetics
- Open expanded profiles, customize personal and game widgets, and drag them into your preferred order
- Import saved accounts from the Discord desktop app and choose your theme during first-launch setup
- Preview message appearance interactively and reorder GIF, sticker, and emoji buttons
- Slowmode now shows a countdown, while timed-out messages support retry and late delivery confirmation
- Collapsed categories keep relevant channels visible, with fixes for drafts, avatar loading, and Escape-key navigation
